keyless.name: LLM7.io
keyless.note: Verified live Nov 11, 2026 (called from a file:// page in Chrome). No key. Only the 2 models listed are on LLM7's free 'turbo' tier right now (its /v1/models marks the other 67 as 'pro'; gpt-oss:20b moved to 'pro' and now returns HTTP 401 without a key). keyless.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints (anonymous)
keyless.note: Verified live Nov 9, Nov 10 and again Nov 11, 2026 (default model, called from a file:// page in Chrome). No key. OVHcloud documents anonymous use at 2 requests per minute per IP per model (extra calls get 429, so the hub moves on). EU-hosted; OVH says data is not stored.

keyless.name: flm.stonech.at (free, no key)
keyless.note: Verified live Nov 9, Nov 10 and again Nov 11, 2026 (default model, called from a file:// page in Chrome). No key. Third-party community service: the model is picked for you (any model name is ignored); its site lists 60 requests/min, 20K requests/day per IP. Prompts go to this host, so the hub only sends public resource names and your tab context.

keyless.name: Pollinations (text.pollinations.ai)
keyless.note: Verified live Nov 9, Nov 10 and again Nov 11, 2026 (default model, called from a file:// page in Chrome). No key. The only anonymous text model is openai-fast (GPT-OSS 20B reasoning, per text.pollinations.ai/models). Slow and fragile: with default settings the hub's prompt failed with HTTP 400 "output token limit exhausted" after 75–85 s (reasoning model), so the hub now sends reasoning_effort=low and max_tokens=8192 (16 s in the same test). Used last.

keyed.name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio)
steps: Sign in at aistudio.google.com with a Google account
Click 'Get API key' then 'Create API key'
Paste it here, then turn Gemini on
keyed.limits: Free tier: Google's pricing page lists 'Free of charge' for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.1 Flash-Lite; Gemini 3.8 / 3.6 Flash are listed as free-tier models on third-party summaries. Exact limits are per project in AI Studio. Free-tier prompts are 'used to improve our products'. gemini-2.5-flash was removed from the list: Google says it is deprecated and routes to 3.5 Flash-Lite on Dec 1, 2026. Checked Nov 9, 2026.
keyed.cors: Yes — Chrome loaded from this file could read the API response (tested Nov 1, 2026 with a dummy key → readable 4xx).

keyed.name: OpenRouter (free models)
steps: Settings → Keys → Create key (no credits needed for :free models)
Paste it here; only ':free' model IDs are free
keyed.limits: Free models (IDs ending ':free'): 20 requests/min; 50 requests/day if you've bought <10 credits ever, 1,000/day with ≥10 credits purchased. Free model list pulled from OpenRouter's public API Nov 9, 2026 (inkling-small was replaced by inkling-2-small); it changes often — use "Refresh model lists".
keyed.cors: Yes — Chrome loaded from this file could read the API response (tested Nov 1, 2026 with a dummy key → readable 4xx).

Create an API key and paste it here

keyed.name: Pollinations (gen.pollinations.ai) — key required
steps: Create a secret key (starts with sk_)
keyed.limits: Needs a key: anonymous calls return 401 "A valid API key is required" (tested Nov 9, 2026, all models). Usage is billed in Pollinations "Pollen" credits; I could not verify a free allowance, so treat it as optional.
